spans.s:
Ūrvaśī
(‘[damsel] born out of the thigh’)
------------------------------------------
When the sages नर and नारायण were performing austerities at the बदरिकाश्रम, इन्द्र sent a few of his अप्सरास् (heavenly damsels) to disturb them. Seeing them, the sage नारायण slapped his own ūru or thigh, from which emerged a damsel who was more beautiful than all of them put together. Since she came out of the ūru, she was called ऊर्वशी.
Later, as a result of a curse by सूर्य (Sun god), she had to live in भूलोक (the earth) as the wife of the king पुरूरवस्.
Once she fell in love with अर्जुन who politely refused her advances. She then cursed him to become a eunuch. This curse came in handy for अर्जुन at the time of living incognito in विराट’s palace. He lived there under the pseudonym बृहन्नला.
